messages:
mia_marketing: Hey team — finalizing the external announcement for the new staged rollout. Need: changelog link, docs canonical URL, and preferred canary window. Also planning a short webinar the week after; who from eng can do a 15-min demo?

dave_eng: Changelog is mostly ready, PR here: https://git.internal/redwood/changelogs/pull/482 — waiting on one tiny wording change (breaking -> behavior change) from docs. Can do a canary starting Tue 09:00-13:00 PT (low traffic).

anya_docs: Docs site staging build is up: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/3.4.0 — canonical prod link will be /release/3.4.0 once review passes. I pushed suggested wording for the behavior-change note in the changelog PR.

mia_marketing: Perfect — can we lock down the canonical link by EOD Monday? Need it for the social post and the blog meta. Also, webinar date: thinking Wed next week 10am PT. @dave_eng would you be able to present 15 min + 10 min Q&A?

dave_eng: Wed 10am PT works. I'll demo the new cache-aware batching controls and the cost/sla tradeoffs. Can someone from product join for Qs? @sam_pm

sam_pm: Yep I'll join. Also, can we stagger the rollout so enterprise tenants get a 24-48h notice before public canary? We should prepare a short mail template and a support playbook.

oliver_ops: We can do enterprise opt-in start Mon 08:00 PT, public canary Tue 09:00 PT. Need engineering freeze by Sun 18:00 PT so we can do perf validation and a smoke deploy on staging overnight. Also request: add a feature flag `release_3_4_0` for quick rollback.

anya_docs: I'll produce the email template and a one-pager support playbook (triage steps + rollback play). Will link from the marketing assets.

mia_marketing: Great — I'll draft the announcement copy and the webinar registration page once I have the canonical docs URL. Can we get a short benchmark blurb (p95 latency and token-cost delta) for the blog? A sentence or two is fine.

dave_eng: Quick blurb: "p95 latency improved ~15% with auto-batching at typical 512-token loads; token cost reduced ~12% due to prefix KV caching for steady-state workloads." I'll drop that into the changelog PR comments so it's captured.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-deploy-2412345678, canary_window=2026-04-07T16:00:00Z..2026-04-07T20:00:00Z, staged_tenants=enterprise_optin

mia_marketing: Awesome — can everyone react with :thumbsup: once your items are locked (changelog wording, docs URL, email template, deploy flag)? We'll publish the announcement 10:00 PT Wed after a short go/no-go at 08:30 PT ops sync.

dave_eng: :thumbsup:

anya_docs: :thumbsup:

sam_pm: :thumbsup:

oliver_ops: :thumbsup:
